title: Introduction
coreMove: A desire starts to work when it becomes definite enough to choose a target, stay near odd openings, and treat defeat as a signal for correction.

exampleSpecs.audience: a worker entering through a modest role
exampleSpecs.stakes: East Orange can become proximity to Thomas A. Edison only if the aim remains partnership rather than any respectable job.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use Barnes arriving at East Orange with no money or standing and an exact aim to work with Edison.

exampleSpecs.audience: a product lead noticing a problem others avoid
exampleSpecs.stakes: The Edison Dictating Machine looks unattractive until prepared desire reads it as Barnes's opening.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show a neglected product becoming the opportunity because others are uninterested.

exampleSpecs.audience: a manager deciding what a failed test means
exampleSpecs.stakes: Darby's Colorado mine shows that quitting before diagnosis can sell the claim three feet from the ore.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the three feet and mining engineer details to separate surrender from diagnosis.

exampleSpecs.audience: a salesperson turning a loss into a rule
exampleSpecs.stakes: Darby's mining loss later becomes persistence in life insurance rather than a warning never to try again.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show the mining defeat becoming a sales practice after prospects say no.

exampleSpecs.audience: a junior person holding a clear ask
exampleSpecs.stakes: The tenant farmer's daughter in the old mill wins by keeping one fifty-cent demand concentrated.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the old mill and fifty cents to show persistence without rank or force.

exampleSpecs.audience: a reader tempted to wait for a slogan
exampleSpecs.stakes: The Carnegie secret is withheld so readiness depends on recognizing the pattern in Barnes, Darby, and the child.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show delayed naming forcing active pattern detection rather than passive receipt.
